# Review-body lint refuses a linked Round-1 Review ID, admits an empty one

## Context

The Engine's post-submit review lint keeps a byte-for-byte copy of the Brain service's Round-2 shape checks. `agent-pr-review-body-lint.yml` says so above `ROUND_2_DISPOSITION_ROW_PATTERN`, and warns that a format landing in one copy only makes the managed path and CI disagree. The Brain half of this defect is neomjs/neo-agent-brain#380. There, both @neo-gpt (on #18949) and @neo-gpt-emmy (on #18970) had a Round 2 refused today for linking the Round-1 Review ID. This ticket is the CI copy, and it must land with the Brain fix.

## The Problem

`.github/workflows/agent-pr-review-body-lint.yml:433` tests `/\*\*Round-1 Review ID:\*\*\s*(?!\[)\S/`, the same predicate as the service. A leading `[` reads as the template placeholder, so a Markdown link `[5256218531](URL)` is refused. `\s*` and `\S` also let an empty value borrow the ` · ` separator or the next line. Measured, the same table as the Brain ticket:

| Value after the anchor | Today | Intended |
|---|---|---|
| the template placeholder `[reviewId or URL] · …` | refused | refused |
| `[5256218531](https://…#pullrequestreview-5256218531)` | **refused** | accepted |
| `PRR_…`, `` `PRR_…` ``, digits, a bare URL, `PRR_… ([id](url))` | accepted | accepted |
| empty before ` · ` | **accepted** | refused |
| empty at the end of the line | **accepted** | refused |

Once only the service is fixed, a linked id passes the managed gate and then fails this lint's `core.setFailed` post-submit, which reds the PR.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/workflows/agent-pr-review-body-lint.yml`, the `isRound2Disposition` branch: the `round2Misses` check at `:433`.
- Its only executable harness is the Brain spec's `runAgentPrReviewBodyLintWorkflow()` (`PullRequestService.spec.mjs`). That harness loads this file from `process.cwd()`, so it runs only with an Engine checkout as the working directory.

## The Fix

Replace the predicate with the Brain's, byte for byte:

`/\*\*Round-1 Review ID:\*\*[ \t]*(?!\[[^\]\n]*\](?!\())[^\s·]/`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The lint's predicate equals the one merged for neomjs/neo-agent-brain#380, byte for byte.
- [ ] Every row of the table lands in its Intended column when this lint runs through the Brain spec's workflow harness.

## Out of Scope

Retiring the duplicate copy (the service and CI sharing one module), and any other Round-2 check.
